legacy.semantics: discrete nearest-channel center track plus fixed boxcar radius; not Gaussian-tail or astrophysical exposure completeness

regression_cases.experiment_kind: original sampled-power regression scenarios; numerical start-coordinate comparison, separate from integrated-power sensitivity

truth.coordinate_handling: relative Hz inside SETIGEN; absolute Hz restored for truth reporting
truth.injection_domain: additive detected power; no voltages, phase, or stochastic transmitter noise
truth.profile: constant-amplitude Gaussian in frequency; center f(t)=f0+drift*t
truth.randomness: none; fixed observation and deterministic injection
truth.time_frequency_integration: sampled at channel centers and integration starts; no intra-integration drift smearing

score_compatibility: Same row normalization and drift grid; profile normalization now uses all valid starts at each drift. V2 scores are not assumed identical/calibrated against the old common-guard scores.

v2.definition: nearest-channel linear path plus complete boxcar at every stored integration
v2.frequency_reference: midpoint of first stored integration; time_s remains integration-start metadata
v2.score_definition: whole-valid-profile per-drift median/MAD track-power standardization; descriptive, not false-alarm probability
